title: Medical facials in Cairo
description: Find out how a medical facial in Cairo is tailored to dry, dull or congested skin, what cleansing and extraction involve and when irritation needs a review.
answer: Medical facials combine selected cleansing and skincare steps to address surface buildup, dryness or dullness. At {{brand}} in New Cairo and Mohandessin, each visit begins by reviewing sensitivity, recent treatments and the products used at home. The steps can be adjusted, or a facial postponed if the skin is inflamed.
preparation: We check your skin's condition and sensitivity, and ask what you use at home.
howPerformed: A medical facial starts with a skin assessment. Depending on your needs, it may include cleansing, exfoliation, extraction, massage and selected skincare products.
followup: A simple facial may need little recovery time, though temporary redness can occur. Microneedling and other added procedures can need longer. We will explain aftercare for the session you choose.
suitability: A facial may help with dryness, congestion or dullness, but the steps need to suit your skin. Tell us about active irritation, allergies or recent treatments before booking.
outlook: Skin may feel cleaner, softer and more hydrated after a facial. The visible change and how long it lasts depend on your skin and the steps included.

faqs.q: How is this different from a spa facial?
faqs.a: At {{brand}}, the session starts with an assessment of your skin and medical history. The products and steps are chosen around that assessment, with advice on aftercare and your home routine.

faqs.q: Can I have a facial before a big event?
faqs.a: Tell us your event date and whether you have had the treatment before. We can suggest timing that allows for possible redness or sensitivity, especially if the session includes extraction or microneedling.
OxyGeneo is a facial treatment that combines exfoliation with the application of skincare ingredients. Ask our team which option is available and whether it suits your skin.
Discomfort varies with the area and method. Describe any previous sensitivity so that suitable comfort measures and pauses can be discussed.

faqs.q: How many visits might I need?
faqs.a: Every 4 to 6 weeks (adjusted to your skin's needs)

faqs.q: Can I go back to my usual routine afterwards?
faqs.a: A simple facial may need little recovery time, though temporary redness can occur. Microneedling and other added procedures can need longer. We will explain aftercare for the session you choose.

faqs.q: Can I have treatment if my skin marks easily?
faqs.a: A history of prolonged irritation or dark marks affects planning. Tell the team how your skin healed after previous procedures so the method and timing can be assessed.
Yes. The assessment is individual and takes account of your medical history, goals and the area of concern.
The quote depends on the areas, treatment method and number of visits agreed after assessment. Ask the branch on WhatsApp for a personal quote.
